title: feat: expose speech models through simple audio route
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Makes every `/v1/audio/speech` model available through `GET /audio/{text}`.
- Routes GET and POST through one shared speech-generation function for safety, fallback, provider dispatch, usage, and billing.
- Enables `eleven-dialogue` on GET using one `voice: text` turn per line while keeping its pricing and provider route unchanged.
- Updates Scalar/OpenAPI descriptions and tests endpoint parity plus exact ElevenLabs translation.

Tests: gen audio route, dialogue, cache/coordinator, permissions, docs, safety, billing, usage, tracking, TypeScript, and Biome.

gist.headline: Speech takes the short route
gist.blurb: The simple audio URL learned some new voices. Every speech model, including dialogue, can now turn a bit of text into sound without taking the scenic POST route.
gist.summary: All `/v1/audio/speech` models are now available through `GET /audio/{text}`, with GET and POST sharing the same safety, fallback, provider dispatch, usage, and billing path; `eleven-dialogue` translates each line into a `voice: text` turn.
gist.impact: Builders can use the short `/audio/{text}` URL for the full speech-model catalog, including multi-voice ElevenLabs dialogue, while receiving the same generation behavior and accounting as the API route.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli opening a small garden-path shortcut marked `/audio/{text}` that leads into a cozy retro speaker and microphone booth, with several friendly speech bubbles becoming warm sound-wave flowers. A CRT monitor robot can hold a dialogue script with neat `voice: text` lines, showing that multiple voices now travel through the same shared route.
